notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is an 'other governmental fund'; no business-type funds, so business_type null). Receipts/disbursements from the Total Governmental Funds column (trimmed pp4-5 = report pp7-8); the printed receipts/disbursements by function tie to the printed totals. Transfers of 21,162 (General to Activities) net to zero in the total column, so transfers_in/out are null; Depreciation Fund also receives 500,000 from General (p14) which is eliminated in the reclassifications column (p7-8), so total column spending already excludes it. Beginning/ending cash = fund balances 67,062,969 and 53,840,403 (p5), which equal total net position; balance sheet = Statement of Net Position (p3), cash 46,054,138 + county treasurer 8,130,995. Roll-forward: 67,062,969 + 65,187,018 - 78,409,584 = 53,840,403. Public power district sales tax and carline tax recorded as other taxes. State receipts 25,227,643 include homestead, property tax credit and pro-rate (state aid, not taxes). Cooperative receipts treated as local-government payments (review). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (pp9-13) used instead of the General Fund Components combining schedule (pp7-8, same fund, less detailed; not recorded to avoid double counting); function-level budgets printed on headings are not recorded, only line budgets. General Fund spending lines are by function only (not itemized). Hidden-transfer handling: the General Fund components schedule (p7) reclassifies 500,000 out of program disbursements as a transfer to the Depreciation Fund, so General Fund detail has a -500,000 contra expenditure line plus a -500,000 other financing line; the printed total 46,264,550 = lines 46,243,388 + 21,162 transfer, so with the contra the expenditure items total 45,743,388 and other financing -521,162 (sum of magnitude 46,264,550). Statement of Activities (pp1-2) program-receipt columns not recorded separately. Read pages 1-21 of 21
